tenderEligibilityCriterionList.description:
Tenderers should not be associated, or have been associated in the
 past, directly or indirectly, with a firm or any of its affiliates which  have been engaged by the Purchaser to provide consulting services for the  preparation of the design, specifications, and other documents to be used  for the procurement of the goods to be purchased under this Invitation of  Tenders.


Bidders shall not be under a declaration of ineligibility for
 corrupt and fraudulent practices issued by Government of Karnataka

It shall be the responsibility of the Bidder to ensure credit of Tender Processing Fee and EMD into the respective receiving bank accounts of e-Procurement on or before the last date and time of bid submission.
EMD Payments through e-Payment mode shall be made as one single transaction and payments made in part are liable for rejection.

tenderTechnicalCriterionList.description: The tenderer should be a manufacturer who must have manufactured, tested and supplied the equipment (s) similar to the type specified in the ‘Schedule of Requirements’ up to at least xxxx % of the quantity required in any one of the last 3 years. The equipments offered for supply must be of the most recent series models incorporating the latest improvements in design. The models should have been released on or after xxxxx and be in satisfactory operation for xxxxx months as on date of tender opening. Certificates to be provided as per Section XII of Tender Document.

In case of authorized representative/dealer of a manufacturer - The manufacturer furnishes authorization in the prescribed format assuring full guarantee and warranty obligations as per General Conditions of Contract and Special Conditions of Contract. Manufacturers Authorization Form to be provided as per Section XIII of Tender Document.

In case of authorized representative/dealer of a manufacturer - The tenderer, as authorized representative/dealer , has supplied, installed and commissioned satisfactorily at least xxxxx % of the quantity similar to the type specified in the Schedule of Requirements in any one of the last three years which must be in satisfactory operation for at least xxxxx months on the date of tender opening. Certificates to be provided as per Section XII of Tender Document.
The legal status, place of registration and principal place of business of the company or firm or partnership.

Details of experience and past performance of the tenderer on equipment offered and on those of similar nature within the past three/five years2 and details of current contracts in hand and other commitments.
A detailed description of the essential technical and performance characteristics of the goods.

A list giving full particulars, including available sources and current prices, of spare parts, special tools, etc., necessary for the proper and continuing functioning of the goods for a period of two years, following commencement of the use of the goods by the Purchaser.

Annual Turnover: The Bidder must have an average annual turnover of at least Rs.30,00,000/- over the last three financial years (2023-24, 2024-25, and 2025-26). Turnover details and supporting documents must be submitted as Annexure-1 (Financial Status). Bidder should have positive net worth during last 3 financial years. This turnover information will only be accepted if accompanied by a certificate from a Chartered Accountant.

Experience: The bidder shall have supplied and installed MFD Laser Printers, Computers, and IT hardware worth Rs. 30,00,000/-, in a single or multiple projects during the any of last 3 financial years.

Details of the Bidder: Company Information shall be furnished as per Annexure-3. Bidder/OEM shall have a head office/Regional office in Bengaluru. Bidder shall also upload Certificate of Incorporation / Certificate of Partnership along with Annexure-3
Manufacturer Authorization form (MAF)- MAF issued by OEM, to the bidder/authorized dealer/ SI shall be submitted as per Annexure 4.

Undertaking by OEM-The quoted products shall not be declared End-of-Life (EOL) for a minimum of three (3) years. The Original Equipment Manufacturer (OEM) must provide a formal undertaking to this effect, guaranteeing that spare parts and service support will remain available for at least five (5) years from the date of supply.

Service Centre: To meet the technical qualification criteria, the Bidder/OEM must maintain the support infrastructure: a) A head office or regional office with established service and technical support facilities in Bengaluru, b) Service and technical support presence in at least four revenue regions of the State and c) A minimum of one service representative stationed at every district headquarters.
Direct Presence of OEM: The OEM of the quoted product must have a direct presence in India. Documentary evidence confirming the same must be submitted along with Annexure-7.

SERVICE & RMA Setup of OEM: The OEM of the quoted product must maintain i) a dedicated online product support center, ii) a toll-free number accessible during standard working hours, and iii) a fully equipped repair and maintenance facility in India. Supporting documents confirming these facilities must be submitted along with Annexure-8.

PRODUCT CERTIFICATES: All systems and components must comply with ISO Standard /CE/ FCC/ UL/ BIS certifications or requisite Certificates if any, to meet the compliance of Government Orders / Circulars / Notifications / LAW. BIS certificate shall be in the name of quoted OEM factory only. Production of copies of relevant certificates is mandatory.
PROCESS & QUALITY CERTIFICATIONS: OEM shall have CMMI level 3/ISO-9001 or Higher certification. Production of copies of relevant certificates is mandatory.
PRODUCT WARRANTY: All products and accessories shall have an OEM warranty of a minimum of 05 years. A letter from the OEM confirming this shall be attached with the tender.

The Undertaking by Participant/Bidder in conformity with the following:Undertaking by participant/ Bidder in pursuance of Govt. Circular on Border Country Land sharing - vide circular no: FD 455 Exp-12/2020, dated 10.03.2021, and clarifications issued by the office Memorandum No: F.18/37/2020-PPO, Dtd: 08.02.2021, or any other GO issued later as per the pro-forma attached at Annexure-14. Other Tender Terms and Conditions
Startup Company: Bidder to indicate whether Clause No. 22(n) for Startup companies is applicable. If yes, the relevant document is to be enclosed separately for scrutiny.
